propositions: Process-local lru_cache on _rendered() causes each xdist worker to independently re-render all 178 corpus bodies, resulting in three full cache fills and ~56s additional CPU under -n 3 --dist worksteal
The three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical tests each redundantly recompute render_markdown_to_wiki(body) for pass 1, duplicating work already cached by _rendered()

Replace process-local cache with a session-scoped disk artifact shared across xdist workers, keyed by SHA-256 digest of corpus files, wiki_render source, and pandoc executable metadata to prevent stale renders

Shard the artifact per stratum with worker-rotated probe order and os.mkdir-based mutual exclusion with 150s fallback deadline to allow concurrent non-overlapping fills and graceful degradation on winner crash
Fixed-point tests must read pass 1 from the shared artifact instead of recomputing it, while retaining their own pass 2 and conditional pass 3 renders to maintain real coverage
